# Company 021 — Lead Qualification Infrastructure

**Company ID:** `company:future:021`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:021`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-021-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no outbound messaging, list purchasing, scraping behind access controls or sales contact.

## Business identity

Purpose: verify, enrich, score, route and explain inbound/authorized lead records so companies can distinguish real potential customers from spam, fraud, duplicates and low-fit submissions.

Problem: lead systems mix incomplete identities, bots, duplicate contacts, invalid companies and weak intent signals; sales teams waste time and automation can amplify junk.

Value: trustworthy lead identity/fraud/fit/intent decisions with source provenance and configurable routing.

Delivery: API, batch enrichment, form/webhook gateway, CRM plugin, real-time scoring, private/enterprise deployment, embedded/OEM.

## Product tree

Lead Verification; Email/Phone/Domain Validation; Person/Company Enrichment; Firmographic Fit; Intent Signal Intake; Spam/Bot/Fraud Detection; Duplicate/Entity Resolution; Lead Scoring; Routing/Assignment; Account Matching; ICP/Segment Rules; Batch Cleanup; Real-Time Form Gateway; Conversion Feedback Learning; Lead Source Quality Analytics; Lead Privacy/Consent Metadata; Developer API/SDK; Vertical Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree

Features: identity confidence, source attribution, opt-in/consent flags, company/domain matching, employee/size/industry/location where lawfully sourced, duplicate clusters, bot/device/rate signals, form quality, historical conversion features, configurable scorecards, ML scores, reason codes, routing rules, SLA, quarantine, audit/export, privacy deletion.

Customers: B2B SaaS, agencies, services, marketplaces, ecommerce high-value inquiries, enterprise sales, franchises, recruiting/education inquiry workflows where lawful, CRM/marketing platforms embedding qualification.

Verticals: B2B SaaS, professional/home services, agencies, industrial, logistics, software/dev tools, education inquiries, marketplaces. Regulated credit/insurance/employment decisions require separate compliance and may prohibit certain signals.

## Brain / architecture

Brain understands fit/intent context, source reliability and conversion history, recommends score/routing changes and explains uncertain records. Deterministic validation/fraud/routing rules own real-time gates; ML predicts fit/conversion; LLM only interprets free-form inquiry text with prompt-injection isolation.

## Agents

Identity/Enrichment Agent, Company Resolver, Fit Analyst, Intent Analyst, Spam/Fraud Agent, Duplicate Resolver, Scorecard Optimizer, Routing Agent, Source Quality Agent, Privacy/Consent Agent, Conversion Attribution Agent, Data Quality Agent.

## Deterministic services

Validation APIs; rate/bot controls; entity resolver; enrichment connectors; consent metadata; scoring engine; routing rules; CRM/webhook connectors; quarantine; audit; deletion; attribution feedback.

## Workflow

Lead event → validate source/consent → identity/company resolution → fraud/spam → enrich authorized fields → compute fit/intent → score with reasons/confidence → route/quarantine → downstream team acts → conversion/outcome feedback → recalibrate with fairness/privacy review.

## Integrations / API / data

Forms, CRM, marketing automation, product analytics, webhooks, email verification, public/licensed data providers, customer data warehouse, scheduling, support. API for verify/enrich/score/route/source-quality and batch jobs.

Data moat: entity matching, source-quality history, conversion-calibrated scores, industry ICP templates and fraud patterns; no unauthorized personal-data collection.

## Monetization / distribution

Per record/API, batch, seats, CRM plugin, enterprise/private, premium enrichment, OEM. Distribution through CRM/form/marketing marketplaces, sales ops agencies/integrators, developer APIs.

## Security/privacy/legal

Data minimization, source rights, consent, regional privacy, deletion/export, no protected-class profiling, no prohibited eligibility decisions, untrusted form text isolation, rate/bot abuse prevention.

## Failure / edge cases

Shared domains, consultants using personal emails, stealth startups, VPNs, duplicate aliases, fraudulent enrichment, stale employer data, high-fit low-intent leads, new market cold start. Use confidence/reasons and never discard solely on opaque model score when business risk warrants review.

## Scale / overlap

Small form gateway → enterprise lead decision service → embedded qualification infrastructure. Adjacent #20 cleanup, #57 fraud, #13 intelligence; keep #021 focused on authorized lead qualification.

## Classification

**DESIGN NOW:** untrusted-input, identity/provenance/privacy, model/evidence, routing-policy interfaces.  
**BUILD NOW:** generic intake/security/identity interfaces after reverse-map.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** company/customer-data isolation, consent metadata, connector registry.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** enrichment providers/models/CRM products.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** broad identity network/benchmarking.

# Mandatory 24-part completion block

1. Product Tree: verify, enrich, fit, intent, spam/fraud, dedupe, scoring, routing, matching, ICP, batch, form gateway, analytics, privacy, API.
2. Feature Tree: identity/source/consent/firmographics/device/form/history/score/reasons/rules/SLA/quarantine/audit/delete.
3. Customer Tree: B2B SaaS/services/agencies/marketplaces/enterprise/franchises/platforms.
4. Vertical Tree: SaaS, services, industrial, logistics, dev tools, education inquiries, marketplaces.
5. Brain Tree: fit/intent/source-quality reasoning and score explanations; prohibited uses constrained.
6. Agent Tree: identity/company/fit/intent/fraud/dedupe/score/routing/source/privacy/attribution/quality.
7. Service Tree: validation, rate/bot, entity, enrichment, consent, scoring, routing, connectors, quarantine, audit/delete.
8. Workflow Tree: ingest→consent→resolve→fraud→enrich→score→route→outcome→recalibrate.
9. Integration Tree: forms/CRM/marketing/analytics/webhooks/data/scheduling/support/providers.
10. Data Tree: leads/entities/sources/consent/enrichment/scores/routes/outcomes/quality.
11. API Tree: verify/enrich/score/route/source/batch.
12. Monetization Tree: record/API/batch/seats/plugins/enterprise/private/OEM.
13. Distribution Tree: CRM/form marketplaces, agencies/integrators, APIs.
14. Automation Tree: validation/enrichment/scoring/routing/quarantine; sensitive decisions reviewable.
15. Moat Tree: entity/source/conversion/fraud/ICP corpus.
16. Platform Tree: lead API→decision gateway→embedded qualification layer.
17. Risk Tree: privacy, bias, bad enrichment, false rejection, prohibited eligibility use, malicious input.
18. Scale Tree: forms→enterprise→embedded infrastructure.
19. Spinoff Tree: adjacent #20/#57; no duplicate new company.
20. Command Center Dependencies: identity/privacy, untrusted-input security, model/eval, connectors, company isolation.
21. Design-Now: provenance/consent/reasoned scoring/routing contracts.
22. Build-Now: shared intake/security/model hooks after reverse-map.
23. Safe-to-Defer: external enrichment/CRM/product/pricing.
24. Autonomous Mature State: inbound leads auto-verify/score/route within privacy/risk policy; humans handle ambiguous/high-value exceptions.

## Saturation result

Further branches become sales/marketing workflows, fraud or cleanup modules already covered elsewhere.

# Company 022 — Cybersecurity Hygiene Autopilot for SMBs

**Company ID:** `company:future:022`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:022`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-022-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no scanning of unauthorized systems, credential changes, remediation, insurance claims or security representations.

## Business identity

Purpose: give small and midsize businesses continuous visibility and prioritized remediation for everyday security hygiene without requiring a full security team.

Problem: SMBs miss MFA, stale accounts, exposed services, unpatched software, weak backups, overbroad SaaS permissions and access-review tasks.

Value: low-friction posture inventory, prioritized risk, evidence, guided remediation and recurring hygiene automation.

Delivery: SaaS dashboard, lightweight connectors/agents, API, MSP console, private/self-hosted option, insurance-readiness reports, vertical packs.

## Product tree

Identity/MFA Posture; Account/Permission Review; External Exposure Inventory; Patch/Vulnerability Hygiene; SaaS Security Posture; Backup/Recovery Posture; Device Security Posture; Password/Credential Hygiene; Phishing/Email Security Readiness; Cloud/IAM Basics; Access Review Calendar; Employee Offboarding Checks; Security Score; Remediation Playbooks; Evidence/Insurance Readiness; Vendor/SaaS Risk Lite; Incident Readiness Checklist; API/MSP Console; Vertical Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree

Features: asset/account inventory, connector health, MFA coverage, stale/dormant users, admin roles, external ports/domains/certs, patch age, endpoint/security flags, backup freshness/restore evidence, SaaS sharing, email DNS, risk priority, remediation owner, due date, evidence, exceptions, recurring scans, alerts, accessible reports.

Customers: SMBs, nonprofits, professional services, local/multi-location businesses, agencies, ecommerce, healthcare-adjacent admin, contractors, MSPs/IT consultants. Verticals with high regulatory burden require specialist packs and do not treat a hygiene score as compliance certification.

## Brain / architecture

Brain interprets posture, prioritizes likely business risk and explains remediation; deterministic checks own evidence. It may draft remediation steps but cannot execute credential/security changes without explicit protected policy. Architecture: connector registry, asset graph, rules/controls, vulnerability/reference feeds, risk scoring, event scheduler, evidence store, LLM explanation only with cited observations.

## Agents

Asset Inventory Agent, Identity/MFA Agent, Permission Review Agent, Exposure Monitor, Patch/Vulnerability Agent, SaaS Posture Agent, Backup Agent, Email Security Agent, Risk Prioritizer, Remediation Planner, Evidence Agent, Offboarding Agent, MSP Portfolio Agent, Incident Readiness Agent.

## Deterministic services

Connectors; asset/account registry; posture rules; vulnerability/version matching; DNS/cert checks; backup freshness/restore evidence; scheduler; alerting; risk calculation; evidence/audit; remediation task tracking; protected action gate.

## Workflow

Connect authorized systems → inventory → run noninvasive posture checks → calculate evidence-backed findings → prioritize by exposure/business impact → assign remediation → owner/IT approves action → external systems remediate → recheck/verify → close evidence → recurring review.

## Integrations / API / data

Identity suites, cloud, endpoint/MDM, SaaS admin, backup, email/DNS, password manager metadata, ticketing, HR/offboarding, vulnerability/security feeds. APIs for assets/findings/evidence/remediation/status/score.

Data moat: SMB-normalized control library, remediation outcomes, asset/identity relationship models and connector coverage; customer security data remains strictly isolated.

## Monetization / distribution

Per company/user/device/domain/connector, MSP multi-tenant, premium evidence/recovery drills, enterprise/private, vertical packs, managed security-hygiene service. Distribution through MSPs, insurers/brokers where appropriate, IT consultants, accounting/business-service ecosystems and cloud marketplaces.

## Security/privacy/legal

The platform is security-sensitive: strict least privilege, secret refs, no raw password storage, authorized targets only, safe/non-destructive checks by default, no false “secure/compliant” claims, audit, regional privacy, protected remediation/credential actions.

## Failure / edge cases

Connector outage, stale inventory, false vulnerable version, managed device offline, intentional legacy exception, shared admin account, backup appears healthy but never restored, phishing simulation misuse, external scan mistaken as attack. Use evidence timestamps, confidence, exceptions, restore tests and explicit unknown status.

## Scale/platform/overlap

Single SMB → MSP portfolios → enterprise-lite security posture platform. Adjacent #73 secret rotation, #74 permissions, #75 access reviews, #82 backup integrity, #83 domain/DNS, #84 deliverability. Keep #022 as broad SMB hygiene umbrella.

## Classification

**DESIGN NOW:** security action classes, connector/asset identity, evidence/truth states, company isolation, safe read-only posture checks.  
**BUILD NOW:** Command Center security/evidence/provider interfaces should support this pattern after reverse-map.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** company security namespace, connector/secret isolation, audit/incident framework.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** actual posture checks/connectors/customer portal/pricing.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** MSP/global multi-tenant fleet and advanced automated remediation.

13. Distribution Tree: MSP/IT consultants/insurance/business-service/cloud ecosystems.
14. Automation Tree: posture scans/prioritization/reminders/rechecks; destructive remediation gated.
15. Moat Tree: SMB control/remediation corpus, connectors, asset graph, trusted evidence.
16. Platform Tree: hygiene checklist→continuous posture→MSP security operations layer.
17. Risk Tree: unauthorized scan, stale/false findings, secret exposure, destructive remediation, false assurance.
18. Scale Tree: single SMB→MSP portfolios→large multi-tenant platform.
19. Spinoff Tree: existing #73/#74/#75/#82/#83/#84 cover deep specialist products.

# Company 023 — Contract Obligation Tracker

**Company ID:** `company:future:023`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:023`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-023-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; not legal advice and no contract acceptance/termination.

## Business identity

Purpose: turn executed contracts and amendments into a reliable obligation/deadline/renewal system with source-linked evidence and owner-controlled workflows.

Problem: notice periods, renewals, price escalators, deliverables, insurance requirements, SLAs and obligations are buried in documents and forgotten.

Value: structured contract repository, obligations calendar, risk alerts, compliance evidence and negotiation intelligence.

Delivery: SaaS, document ingestion/API, calendar/workflow integration, private deployment, enterprise repository, embedded/OEM contract-obligation module.

## Product tree

Contract Repository; Metadata/Party Extraction; Obligation/Deliverable Tracker; Renewal/Notice Calendar; Pricing/Escalator Tracker; SLA/Service-Credit Tracker; Insurance/Certificate Requirement Tracker; Compliance/Reporting Obligation; Clause Library; Amendment/Supersession Graph; Risk/Exception Register; Contract-to-Invoice/Usage Reconciliation; Negotiation/Benchmark Intelligence; Approval/Review Workflow; Contract Health Dashboard; Search/Q&A with citations; API/SDK/OEM; Vertical Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree

Features: parties/entity IDs, effective/expiry/notice dates, renewal type, clauses, obligation owner, frequency, conditions, evidence required, deliverables, pricing schedules, thresholds, SLA measurements, amendment hierarchy, citations/page locations, confidence, legal-review status, reminders, escalation, audit, access controls, retention/hold.

Customers: SMB/enterprise legal ops, procurement, finance, vendor management, sales ops, property/service businesses, SaaS, agencies, manufacturers, nonprofits, public contractors.

Verticals: SaaS/vendor contracts, customer/MSA/SOW, leases/property, construction/subcontract, procurement, logistics, professional services, licensing, insurance/vendor compliance. Highly specialized legal domains need counsel review.

## Brain / architecture

Brain extracts and explains clauses/obligations, maps amendments, detects conflicts and suggests tasks/negotiation questions with citations. It cannot interpret law conclusively or accept/terminate/modify contracts.

Architecture: document parser/OCR, clause/obligation ontology, relational contract graph, temporal calendar, search/RAG with exact citations, deterministic deadline/recurrence/price calculations, workflow/evidence store.

## Agents

Contract Intake Agent, Clause/Obligation Extractor, Date/Renewal Agent, Amendment Resolver, Pricing/SLA Analyst, Obligation Monitor, Evidence Collector, Risk Agent, Invoice/Usage Reconciliation Agent, Negotiation Prep Agent, Search/Q&A Agent, Legal-Review Coordinator.

## Deterministic services

Document ingestion; hash/version; OCR/parser; entity resolver; date/recurrence; amendment graph; obligation scheduler; reminders; SLA calculators; pricing schedule engine; workflow/approval; search/index; audit/export/retention.

## Workflow

Ingest executed doc → verify version/parties → extract metadata/clauses/obligations with citations → human/legal review thresholds → activate calendar/tasks → collect evidence → alert notice/renewal/SLA/price → reconcile amendments → prepare action → protected legal/financial decision outside tracker → archive supersession.

## Integrations / API / data

DMS/e-sign, email/storage, procurement/vendor systems, accounting/AP/AR, CRM/CPQ, calendar/tasks, insurance/COI, usage/SLA monitoring, BI. APIs for contracts/clauses/obligations/deadlines/renewals/evidence/search.

Data moat: clause/obligation ontology, reviewed extraction corpus, amendment-resolution patterns, contract lifecycle evidence and benchmark metadata where lawfully aggregated.

## Monetization / distribution

Contracts/users/entities, extraction/document pages, vertical packs, enterprise/private, API/OEM, premium analytics/benchmarking, managed migration. Distribution via legal/procurement/finance ecosystems, e-sign/DMS marketplaces, consultants/integrators.

## Security/privacy/legal

Contracts are confidential. Strong access/isolation, encrypted storage, no model training on documents by default, legal holds, retention/export/delete, citation requirements, privileged-material controls, protected acceptance/termination/financial actions.

## Failure / edge cases

Bad scan, unsigned draft mistaken executed, amendment supersession ambiguity, timezone/notice rules, evergreen renewal, conflicting dates, partial termination, oral side agreement absent, legal entity rename, clause cross-references. Surface uncertainty and require human/legal review for material ambiguities.

## Scale/platform/overlap

Small repository → enterprise obligation operations → contract intelligence platform. Overlap #17 SaaS spend, #32 procurement, #52 COI, #85 leakage. #023 remains obligation lifecycle across contract types.

## Classification

**DESIGN NOW:** document provenance, temporal/recurrence, legal/protected-action classification, evidence citations, version/supersession.  
**BUILD NOW:** shared artifact/decision/scheduler patterns after reverse-map.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** confidential document isolation/retention, obligation scheduler, legal-review status.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** contract product/extractors/integrations/pricing.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** large clause benchmark/enterprise repository network.

# Company 024 — Vendor Risk Autopilot

**Company ID:** `company:future:024`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:024`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-024-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no vendor acceptance/rejection, contracting or payments.

## Business identity

Purpose: continuously assess vendor security, privacy, financial, operational, compliance and concentration risk with evidence-backed scoring and recurring reassessment.

Problem: vendor reviews are questionnaire-heavy, point-in-time and disconnected from contracts/incidents/certifications.

Value: normalized vendor profiles, evidence, risk scoring, exceptions, remediation, renewals and continuous monitoring.

Delivery: SaaS, vendor portal, questionnaires, API, enterprise/private deployment, industry packs, managed review support.

## Product tree

Vendor Registry; Intake/Classification; Security Review; Privacy Review; Compliance/Certification Review; Financial/Operational Risk; Concentration/Dependency Risk; Insurance Review; Questionnaire Engine; Evidence/Document Repository; External Incident/Change Monitoring; Risk Scoring; Exception/Remediation; Renewal/Reassessment Calendar; Contract/Obligation Integration; Vendor Graph/Dependency Map; Executive Risk Dashboard; Vendor Portal; API/OEM; Industry Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree

Features: vendor tiering, service/data access, criticality, subprocessors, geography, certifications/expiry, evidence provenance/freshness, questionnaire templates, conditional questions, automated evidence reuse, risk factors/weights, compensating controls, exceptions, owner approvals, remediation deadlines, incident links, renewal triggers, audit/export.

Customers: procurement, security, privacy, GRC, IT, finance/ops, enterprise vendor management, regulated organizations, SaaS, MSPs/consultants.

Verticals: SaaS/cloud, finance operations, healthcare admin, public contractors, ecommerce, education, manufacturing/supply chain. Framework/risk packs vary.

## Brain / architecture

Brain classifies vendor criticality, summarizes evidence, maps questionnaire responses, identifies contradictions/gaps and recommends risk/remediation. Deterministic evidence/freshness/risk-policy rules own status. It cannot approve contracts or certify vendors autonomously.

Architecture: vendor/entity registry, evidence store, document parser, questionnaire/rules engine, risk model, external monitoring feeds, dependency graph, scheduler, search/RAG with citations, audit.

## Agents

Vendor Intake Agent, Questionnaire Agent, Security Reviewer, Privacy Reviewer, Compliance Evidence Agent, Financial/Operational Analyst, Concentration Analyst, Insurance Agent, Evidence Freshness Agent, Remediation Agent, Incident Monitor, Renewal Agent, Risk QA Agent.

## Deterministic services

Vendor registry; tiering rules; questionnaire workflow; evidence hash/version; certification expiry; risk calculator; dependency graph; scheduler; remediation tasks; incident hooks; portal access; audit/export.

## Workflow

Register vendor/service → classify data/access/criticality → request/collect evidence → validate/freshness → questionnaire/risk checks → calculate risk + uncertainty → exception/remediation → owner acceptance decision → monitor incidents/expiry → periodic/renewal reassessment.

## Integrations / API / data

Procurement/ERP, contracts/DMS, security/GRC, IAM/SaaS inventory, insurance/COI, compliance sources, ticketing, incident feeds, finance/vendor master. APIs for vendor/profile/evidence/questionnaire/risk/remediation/renewal.

Data moat: vendor/service graph, evidence normalization, questionnaire answer mappings, incident/remediation history and vertical risk packs, while customer-specific vendor decisions stay isolated.

## Monetization / distribution

Vendors assessed, seats, questionnaires/evidence, enterprise/private, packs, vendor portal, API/OEM, managed review. Distribution through procurement/security/GRC ecosystems, consultants/MSPs, insurance/compliance partners.

## Security/privacy/legal

Vendor evidence is confidential/security-sensitive. Access isolation, no unauthorized sharing, redaction, retention, audit, time-limited vendor portal access, no false certification, protected acceptance/contract actions.

## Failure / edge cases

Outdated certification, questionnaire self-report mismatch, parent/subsidiary confusion, vendor rebrand/acquisition, unknown subprocessor, service scope changes, incident after approval, concentration hidden through resellers, financial-data uncertainty. Preserve source/freshness/confidence and require owner/security judgment for material ambiguity.

## Scale / overlap

Small vendor list → enterprise continuous third-party risk → dependency/risk network. Overlap #12 compliance, #17 SaaS spend, #23 contracts, #52 COI, #63 vendor onboarding. #024 remains risk assessment/monitoring.

## Classification

**DESIGN NOW:** vendor/entity/integration identities, evidence/freshness, risk/truth states, dependency graph, company isolation.  
**BUILD NOW:** shared provider/integration health and evidence contracts after reverse-map.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** vendor portal/isolation, document/evidence interfaces, scheduler.

**SCALE-ONLY:** broad vendor intelligence network.
